question: which customer has the most jobs this month?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) n FROM work_orders wo JOIN customers c ON c.id=wo.customer_id WHERE wo.created_at>='2026-06-01' AND wo.created_at<'2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
